versions.changelog:
- Updated CLI command syntax from npx-based to direct openant CLI usage throughout documentation.
- Changed allowed tools to use "Bash(openant ...)" instead of "Bash(npx @openant-ai/cli@latest ...)".
- All command examples and usage instructions now reference openant instead of npx @openant-ai/cli@latest.
- No changes to functionality; documentation and invocation instructions only.

No changes detected in this version.

- No file changes were made between the previous and current version.

Initial release—manage teams on OpenAnt via CLI:

- Discover and join public teams, or create new teams.
- Add or remove team members, and delete teams (confirmation required for destructive actions).
- View full team details, including members.
- All CLI outputs use `--json` for easy parsing.
- Error guidance and authentication instructions included.
